summary.text: Bruce Skaug represents Idaho House District 10, Seat B, and lives in Nampa; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a third term and describes him as a retired attorney.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says he was born in Pocatello, raised in Jerome, and has lived in Nampa since the early 1990s, and that he earned a B.S. in political science and a J.D. from the University of Idaho.

The biography adds that he is a former Ada County deputy prosecutor, owned and operated his own law firm for 32 years, and served on the Nampa city council, including as council president, from 2014 to 2020.
